Steward:
Congratulations on becoming a Steward!

Entering the 3rd stage of 1st Colonial Operation, we need new leaders and contributors to the greater entity that serves Super Earth and her colonies. If you choose to remain a Steward, you will still accrue IRON for your participation but will not progress further up the Chain of Command.

**Part of your new responsibilities:**

- Help maintain the standards of the 1st Colonial Regiment
- Support and guide new recruits
- Step in during MODs if there is a shortage of Deployment Caste and lead a team

To earn the next rank, achieve IRON [ V ] (5 IRON) to become eligible for Deployment Officer.
Deployment Officer:
Congratulations on becoming a Deployment Officer!

Please read through the information in **#deployment-materials** for a comprehensive list of responsibilities.

**Your new responsibilities include:**

- Hosting Major Order MODs
- Encouraging activity within the Discord server
- Filing reports during MODs using **#submit-mod-report**
Deployment Supreme:
Welcome to Deployment Supreme! Your leadership plays a critical role in the success of the 1CR.

Please speak with a Fleet Commander about receiving training to run small events within your company.

**Your new opportunities include:**

- Hosting small events

You are one step closer to achieving the rank of Freedom Captain!
Freedom Captain:
Congratulations on becoming a Freedom Captain!

As one of the highest-ranking leaders in the 1CR, please contact High Command or the IRON Commission to receive training for your new responsibilities.

**Your new duties include:**

- Hosting MODs
- Overseeing application onboarding
- Answering support tickets
- Supervising and guiding the regiment
